KIDS’ WALLPAPER

Khel (खेल)

Khel means play, and the mural keeps that promise — red petal rays striped with white, teal shapes dotted like confetti, sweeping deep-green fronds with paint-drip trails, a soft peach ground and bursts of yellow, all in a joyful folk-meets-street-art style. Density is high: colour and shape fill the wall edge to edge. There is no single focal subject, so it crops generously to any wall proportion and stays lively behind desks, beds or play furniture. Made for kids' rooms, teen rooms and playful family spaces — and confident enough for a café wall. Premium Non-Woven keeps its colours bright and its edges clean.
